tools.name: get_place_section
tools.description: Return one published section for this GoVisit place, including Location spatial details. Arrays are limited to at most 20 items and text values are bounded; the result includes page freshness metadata. The overview section includes owner, chain and operator organization names, each null when unknown

tools.name: get_destination_overview
tools.description: Return the published overview for this GoVisit destination. The result includes the long destination description, nullable SEO meta description, and any legacy overview fields, limited to the page's public overview fields and includes freshness metadata from the page snapshot.

tools.name: get_destination_section
tools.description: Read one part of a destination page, such as its overview, highlights, or updates. The experiences section returns every published experience card in the page language across all audiences. Other lists contain up to 20 items.

tools.name: list_destination_places
tools.description: Browse the place cards displayed on a destination's main page. Apply optional filters to that preview and get up to 20 matches. Coverage depends on which cards the page shows.

tools.name: get_category_overview
tools.description: Identify the place category shown on a destination's category page. Read its label, category code, destination identity, and any published count or parent category.

tools.name: get_category_section
tools.description: Read the overview or places section of a destination category page. Choose places to inspect the inventory preview for that category. Lists contain up to 20 items.

tools.name: list_category_places
tools.description: Filter the venue cards shown for one category within a destination, such as Culture. Provide the category page path. Returns up to 20 cards from that inventory preview.

tools.name: get_collection_overview
tools.description: Identify a named destination collection and learn what it brings together. Read its title, description, slug, and any published count.

tools.name: get_collection_section
tools.description: Inspect part of a named collection. Select overview for the introduction, or places for the entries shown on the collection page. Lists contain up to 20 items.

tools.name: list_collection_places
tools.description: Find entries in a named destination collection using its collection page path. Optional filters narrow the existing selection by published card details. Returns up to 20 matches.

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search the published documentation links currently rendered on this GoVisit page and return bounded canonical links and titles.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Search published destinations by name or traveler intent. mode defaults to auto: exact name matches avoid embedding; otherwise name and intent results are combined. tools.name: list_related_places
tools.description: Find nearby suggestions shown on a single place profile. Use the path of the reference place and filter its nearby cards by published details. Returns up to 20 matches.

tools.name: list_destination_highlights
tools.description: Return at most 20 compact published highlight place cards from this destination page. The result is a page-local subset, includes canonical links, and includes freshness metadata.

tools.name: list_destination_categories
tools.description: See how a destination groups its places. Returns up to 20 category labels and codes with available counts and parent categories from the destination page.

tools.name: list_destination_activities
tools.description: Discover activities featured on the destination page, such as walking tours. Returns up to 20 cards from its activity section.

tools.name: get_documentation_page
tools.description: Read the current page's published title, headings and structured content, or one section selected by its heading anchor. Returns the canonical URL and explicit truncation information. Reads only the current rendered page; does not fetch other articles.

tools.name: get_page_faq
tools.description: Return at most 20 FAQs extracted from the current rendered page. An optional query filters the published question and answer text. tools.description: Return exact governed catalog coverage counts and per-metric observation metadata from this cached public page.
